answer_1.quote: We generate coherent amendments from the lobbyist by grounding our experiments in real-world congressional bills associated with companies potentially affected by them.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate the two conflicting goals of the lobbyist as follows: (a) Identification Rate... (b) Benefit Capture Rate...

answer_3.quote: Given only the amendments, the critic scores each candidate company according to which appears to benefit most from the given amendments.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluations. We verify three important aspects for the quality of generations through human evaluations...
answer_4.guideline: We verify three important aspects: 1. Benefit captured in the generated amendments. 2. Verify the substantialness of the benefits. 3. Verify that the quality of re-planning reasoning captures the intended benefits to the benefactor correctly.
